notes.title: Minor fix and improvements
notes.notes: ¡Wire has been updated! This patch fixes a small bug with the mouse hiding feature related to the latest Windows 10 feature update (2004), among other minor improvements.

notes.title: Full controller support, Remote Play on TV and more.
notes.notes:
¡Wire has been updated! The following improvements and new features have been implemented:
[list]
[*] Adjusted menus for better navigation.
[*] Tweaked object interaction.
[*] Full controller support. Many controllers should work correctly out of the box. If required, all buttons can be remapped from the options menu (Options -> Controls).
[*] Wire con now be played using Remote play on TV!
[/list]

notes.title: Added gamepad support
notes.notes:
¡Wire has been updated! The following improvements have been implemented based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Optimized the usability of some menus.
[*] Added gamepad support. Many gamepads should work correctly out of the box. If required, all buttons can be remapped from the options menu (Options -> Controls -> Show gamepad).
[/list]

notes.title: Wire has been released!
notes.notes:
Help Wire restart the network so he can go on his long-awaited holidays! 

Fifteen sectors await you. 

Put on your thinking hat and go fix some repeaters. Wire needs your help!
